name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A skill that makes an AI assistant draw clean, professional-looking diagrams (flowcharts, architecture maps, timelines) instead of the clip-art-looking charts most tools produce.
buyer: A freelance consultant or technical writer who regularly needs client-ready diagrams for proposals and decks but can't afford to hire a designer for every one.
business_use_cases: A freelance technical writer adds 'polished architecture/process diagrams' as a paid add-on line item to existing documentation gigs.
A consulting firm speeds up proposal and pitch-deck creation internally, cutting the designer hours it used to pay for on every deal.
A SaaS company auto-generates clean onboarding and 'how it works' diagrams for their help center without looping in design.

money_ideas.idea: Freelance 'diagram design' add-on service sold alongside technical writing or consulting deliverables
A small content/design agency offers a monthly 'diagram refresh' retainer to clients with living documentation

steal_this: Offer existing freelance clients a flat $150 'make your pitch deck diagrams actually look good' add-on this week using this skill to deliver it in under an hour.
